Flexibility On time delivery We pack your powders, granulates, tablets and dried food. We can also handle any type of fluid. We provide a proper packing for every type of raw material. FOR ALL TYPES OF RAW MATERIALS WE PROVIDE YOU WITH A WIDE RANGE OF PACKING SOLUTIONS DeVe-Pack was founded in 1990. Operating globally, we are an experienced partner providing you with proper packing solutions. • You provide us with the raw materials, we pack them. We fill and print the sachets with the help of our extended range of up-to-date machinery. We offer customized sachets and packing solutions. • With our 10 packaging lines, we deliver up to 500.000 sachets a day and store finished products in our warehouses. • DeVe-Pack believes in innovation and expands its product range continuously. Traditional packing forms are extended with new and exclusive packing possibilities. Together we look for the best solution to meet our customer’s needs. • DeVe-Pack meets international quality standards. A dedicated team operates the packing lines with a keen eye for every detail. Two engineers supervise the production and take care of quality control.
